name: @tejoma/analytics-service
description: Tejoma Analytics Service - Tier 0 (Batch 22). Owns nothing directly - a pure proxy over the monolith's new /internal/analytics/* API for recruiter/admin dashboard analytics (company dashboard stats, per-job stats, recruiter profile stats, skill distribution). candidate-analytics and proficiency-analytics stay on the monolith (both call live matching/shadow-scoring code - see README.md's 'Why this is proxy-only').
